cohort: The cohort consisted of antenatal women who underwent instrumental vaginal deliveries at SMGS Hospital, Jammu between July 2020 and June 2023.
finding: Instrumental vaginal deliveries were found to be infrequent but generally safe when performed by skilled obstetricians, resulting in favorable maternal and neonatal outcomes in the majority of cases.
mod_finding: Forceps deliveries were associated with significantly higher rates of vulval hematoma and more frequent neonatal complications such as facial abrasions, scalp injuries, and cephalhematoma compared to vacuum-assisted deliveries.
